record.original_question: Determine defining equations for the tensor network variety TNS^Γ_{m,n}; if necessary, restrict to specific graph classes Γ or specific assignments of bond and local dimensions.

evidence.quote: Problem 19. Determine equations for the tensor network variety TNS Γm,n . Restrict, if necessary, to particular classes of graphs Γ, or particular assignments of bond and local dimensions.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let Γ = (V, E) be a finite simple graph with vertex set V = {1, …, n} and edge set E. Fix a bond dimension m_e ∈ ℕ for each edge e ∈ E and a local (physical) dimension d_v ∈ ℕ for each vertex v ∈ V. For each vertex v, let H_v = ℂ^{d_v} and for each edge e ∈ E incident to v, let B_{v,e} = ℂ^{m_e}. Form the vector space
   A_v = H_v ⊗ ⨂_{e ∋ v} B_{v,e}.
A tensor T_v ∈ A_v at each vertex v can be contracted along the edges of Γ: for each edge e = {u, v} ∈ E, pair the tensor factor B_{u,e} = ℂ^{m_e} with B_{v,e} = ℂ^{m_e} via the standard bilinear pairing. The contraction yields a tensor
   κ_Γ(T_1, …, T_n) ∈ H_1 ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ H_n.
The tensor network variety TNS^Γ_{m,n} is defined as the Zariski closure in H_1 ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ H_n of the image of the contraction map
   κ_Γ : A_1 × ⋯ × A_n → H_1 ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ H_n,  (T_1, …, T_n) ↦ κ_Γ(T_1, …, T_n).

Problem. Determine an explicit system of polynomial equations defining the variety TNS^Γ_{m,n} as a subvariety of H_1 ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ H_n. If necessary, restrict attention to specific classes of graphs Γ (for example, cycles, trees, or regular lattices) and/or to particular assignments of the bond dimensions (m_e)_{e ∈ E} and local dimensions (d_v)_{v ∈ V}.
artifact.status_search_result: No general defining equations for tensor network varieties TNS^Γ_{m,n} are known. Existing literature (e.g., Ye–Lim on tensor network ranks and subsequent work on tensor network varieties) treats only partial results—dimensions, set-theoretic descriptions, or equations in very restricted cases such as small cycles or trees with specific bond/local dimensions. The general problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Tensor Network Ranks — Ke Ye and Lek-Heng Lim
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses tensor network varieties, their ranks and geometry; equations are not given in general.
status_evidence.claim: Defining equations for tensor network varieties are not provided in general; only partial structural results are available.
